text:
You need someone to complete the GA4 migration, clean up Tag Manager, add new tags, and set up new GA4 reporting without breaking conversion tracking or channel visibility.

I’m Mina Castellan, and I bring 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization, with SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets. For Verdant Skincare, I built a marketing attribution analysis in Google Analytics, BigQuery, Looker Studio, and SQL to compare first-click, last-click, and position-based credit; the result was 18% of ad budget reallocated and CAC down 12% the next quarter. I also built a GA4 migration and tracking plan using Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and BigQuery; 46 events were mapped and there was no gap in year-on-year reporting.

I’d be glad to help with GA4 migration, funnel and channel reporting, and cleaner GTM structure.
